h1: Support reports on volume, top questions and answer rates
overview: You cannot improve support you cannot see. We pull your ticket and chat data and turn it into a report that shows how many messages arrive, what customers ask about most, how quickly you reply and how many questions the helper answered without a person. Every chart comes with a sentence on what it means and one suggested action, so the report is useful on the day you read it.

faq: Where does the data come from?
Your help desk, inbox or chat tool, exported or connected from your own account. We check what is available first and tell you which figures we can report accurately.
Do I get the report once or every month?
Once, as a fixed price starter. If you want a report every month, we quote that separately after you have seen how useful this first one is.
What format will the report be in?
A PDF or shared Google Sheet with charts, and for the top package a live dashboard in Looker Studio or your chosen tool. Everything is yours to keep.
